'''Didi Vatermann''' is a ship Engineer based at '''Vatermann LLC''' in the '''Leesti''' system. She specialises in defensive shield systems, particularly [[Shield Booster|Shield Boosters]].<ref name="edwiki-didi">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Didi_Vatermann Didi Vatermann], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Didi provides '''Grade 5''' Shield Booster engineering and [[Shield Generator]] engineering through Grade 3.<ref name="inara-didi">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/11/ Didi Vatermann — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Leesti
* '''Body:''' Leesti 1 a
* '''Facility:''' Vatermann LLC
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship shields
* '''Referral required:''' [[Selene Jean]]
* '''System permit required:''' No

== Access requirements ==

Access to Didi Vatermann has three stages:<ref name="inara-didi" />

# Reach '''Grade 3 access plus at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Selene Jean]] to receive her referral.
# Reach the Pilots Federation '''Trade rank of Merchant or higher'''.
# Provide '''50 units of Lavian Brandy''' at Vatermann LLC.

The referral, Trade-rank threshold, and commodity contribution are separate conditions. The complete ordered access process, including commodity acquisition and delivery, belongs to [[Unlocking Didi Vatermann]].

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Didi Vatermann increases by:<ref name="inara-didi" />

* crafting modifications at her workshop; or
* selling commodities at Vatermann LLC.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Didi supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-didi" />

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]].

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Didi Vatermann blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade she offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Direct referrals ==

Didi Vatermann has no currently documented direct downstream Engineer referral. Other branches of the network can be followed through [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
